findings.detail: Acquisition-cost-only investment tables are being treated as fair-value holdings leaves even though their source header has no Fair Value column.

rationale: B01 is a quarter-level fair-value completeness flag: 559 of 597 leaves have fair_value, below the 0.95 threshold. Raw source totals show the actual Schedule of Investments total fair value is present and internally anchored at $1,639,681,521, matching the fund-quarter fair value in the bundle. The no-FV rows are localized to separate acquisition-cost-only investment tables whose header is Investment/Type/Acquisition Date/Acquisition Cost ($), not a fair-value schedule. Counting those rows as fair-value holdings leaves is therefore a real scope/classification defect, not a source omission.
